title: Skill Channeling
wikitext:
Channeling allows you to continue casting without being interrupted if you are hit while casting the spell.  This skill is level capped like Divination, Evocation and other spell related abilities, but has a maximum of 200.   You do not need to put a training point into this ability as it will automatically go up as you use your spells.
